edits.current: Contribution base for the family compensation fund: the monthly salary payroll of the employee (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17). Same floor (1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905 in 2026) as the other three bases, but NO 25-SMMLV ceiling - the ceiling applies to the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC only. Bidirectional pair with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary (Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: the CCF base computed by the payroll engine under this rule (wage type 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual', uncapped, is the base on which the CCF 4%, wage type 25110 Family Compensation Fund, is computed). Campo 45 (this field) and campo 95 (T2R2-095) are two separate bases and may legitimately differ: each is populated under its own AT2 v30 rule - campo 45 is the base for the CCF contribution, campo 95 the base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN, which under Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 includes paid rest days - and the engine stores and reports them independently, never deriving one from the other.

edits.current: Compute and STORE five separate bases per employee per month. Three are the IBC for pension, health and occupational risk: total salary-constituting payments, plus the excess over the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30, floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) and capped at 25 SMMLV (COP 43,772,625). The fourth is the IBC CCF of campo 45: the monthly salary payroll of Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 (70% of the integral salary, Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49), floored at 1 SMMLV and NOT capped at 25 SMMLV. The fifth is the PARAFISCAL base of campo 95, defined by Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17: it INCLUDES paid rest days and it is UNCAPPED. Never populate all five from one variable.

edits.current: Marks the employee's exit from the systems settled in the return. AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 16 (position 138, one character supplied by the contributor - 'suministrado por el aportante') admits blank, P, R, X, C or T. For a dependent employee the value is X (withdrawal from all the systems settled) in the period in which the termination date falls, and blank in every other period; P reports a withdrawal from the General Pension System only, and R and C apply to independent contributors. T is reported by the contracting party for independent contributors of type 59 in the planilla type Y and never applies to an employee. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 (T2R2-081), optional under AT2 v30 when RET is reported and always populated by the engine, and drives the contributory days in campos 36 to 39, which run from the first day of the period to the termination date inclusive on the 30-day commercial month (a termination on the last calendar day of the month reports 30 days); the occupational-risk days follow the campo 38 rule (T2R2-038). Source: the termination date of the contract (Contract.End_Date), the same date as the final settlement's termination date and the electronic payroll FechaRetiro (NIE003). A termination processed after the return of its period was paid is reported for that period through a correction return (T2R1-008 = N), not in the period in which the final settlement is paid.

For a dependent employee the value is X (withdrawal from all the systems settled) in the period in which the termination date falls, and blank in every other period; P reports a withdrawal from the General Pension System only, and R and C apply to independent contributors. T is reported by the contracting party for independent contributors of type 59 in the planilla type Y and never applies to an employee. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 (T2R2-081), optional under AT2 v30 when RET is reported and always populated by the engine, and drives the contributory days in campos 36 to 39, which run from the first day of the period to the termination date inclusive on the 30-day commercial month (a termination on the last calendar day of the month reports 30 days); the occupational-risk days follow the campo 38 rule (T2R2-038). Source: the termination date of the contract (Contract.End_Date), the same date as the final settlement's termination date and the electronic payroll FechaRetiro (NIE003). A termination processed after the return of its period was paid is reported for that period, not in the period in which the final settlement is paid, through a correction return (T2R1-008 = N) filed with the same operador that settled the original return, and only where the correction does not lower the contribution: the sum of IBC and the sum of days in the C records must each be equal to or greater than those in the A records, and return type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund of amounts paid in excess (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8, type N, numerals 1 and 2; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A RET omitted from the original return of the same settlement period and filed on type N by the last business day of the month in which payment is due carries no interest on arrears (AT2 v30 type N numeral 2; section 16 'Manejo de planilla tipo N' item h). Where reporting the termination lowers the days or the IBC already paid, PILA is not the channel: the refund ('devolución o reintegro de aportes') is requested from each administradora that received the contributions.
edits.reason: The cell says a late RET goes on planilla N without the AT2 limits; a RET that lowers days or IBC fails the C >= A test and cannot go through PILA.
edits.source: AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8, type N, pp.38-39: '1. [...] No se puede utilizar para correcciones que impliquen devolución de valores pagados en exceso. 2. Para reportar las novedades de retiro, [...] que fueron omitidas en la planilla inicial y que correspondan al mismo periodo de liquidación, siempre y cuando la presentación de esta planilla se realice a más tardar el último día hábil del mes en que debe realizar el pago y no habrá lugar al pago de intereses de mora. En estos casos, solo se permitirán aquellas novedades que en el registro “C” reporten valores iguales o mayores a los reportados en el registro “A”. Cuando el aportante necesite reportar novedades que implique la devolución de aportes lo deberá hacer a través de cada una de las administradoras y solicitar la devolución o reintegro de aportes [...], teniendo en cuenta que la Planilla Integrada de Liquidación de Aportes - PILA, no es el medio para compensar dineros, ni realizar devoluciones a los aportantes.' Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N, pp.45-46: 'Este tipo de planilla solo puede ser liquidada a través del operador de información con el cual se liquidó la planilla inicial [...]'; 'La sumatoria del IBC de los registros C debe ser mayor o igual a la sumatoria del IBC de los registros A y la sumatoria de los días de los registros C debe ser mayor o igual a la sumatoria de días de los registros A.' Section 16 'Manejo de planilla tipo N' item h, p.284: 'Siempre que se utilice el tipo de planilla “N – Planilla Correcciones” los operadores de información deberán liquidar los intereses de mora a que haya lugar de acuerdo con la normativa vigente, a excepción del pago de retroactivos salariales; o del reporte de la novedad de retiro cuando se realice en los plazos establecidos en las disposiciones aplicables [...]'.

edits.current: Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a return type N (correcciones) or M (mora).
edits.proposed: Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return, unless the Superintendencia Financiera has authorised that operador's wind-down; the operador settles the C records (correct values) minus the A records (original values), the C records must be equal to or greater than the A records in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N; §2.1.2.3.9 campo 22). Return type M (mora) settles only periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment; a correction that raises a value is made on type N, not on type M (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8, type M).
edits.reason: Type M is for total absence of payment and AT2 sends value-raising corrections to type N; the type N limits were missing.

AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.9 campo 22, p.144: 'A Cuando se usa este valor, se indica que la información contenida en el respectivo registro es la que corresponde a la liquidación original y que se desea corregir [...] Este registro debe ser cargado por el operador de información con el cual se liquidó la planilla inicial. [...] El operador de información debe calcular el valor correcto de los aportes con base en la información contenida en los registros marcados con C [...] y restar los valores ya liquidados y pagados contenidos en los registros marcados con A'. Disposiciones comunes, p.46: 'por cotizante se deberá reportar un grupo de registros A e inmediatamente después un grupo de registros C.' AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8, type M, p.37: 'M. Planilla mora: Es utilizada para el pago de aportes de períodos respecto de los cuales se encuentra ausencia total del pago [...] No podrá incluirse en este tipo de planilla otro sistema respecto del cual se esté realizando una corrección para incrementar un valor [...] pues ese tipo de corrección debe hacerse mediante la Planilla tipo N.' AT2 v30 §2.1.1.1 campos 9 and 10, pp.27-28: 'Debe dejarse en blanco cuando el tipo de planilla sea E, A, I, M, [...]' / 'se incluirá el número de la planilla del período correspondiente cuando el tipo de planilla sea N, F o W'.

edits.current: A adds a contributor omitted from the original return; C corrects a contributor already reported. Only meaningful on a correction return.

Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N, pp.45-46: 'Este tipo de planilla solo puede ser liquidada a través del operador de información con el cual se liquidó la planilla inicial [...]'; 'La sumatoria del IBC de los registros C debe ser mayor o igual a la sumatoria del IBC de los registros A y la sumatoria de los días de los registros C debe ser mayor o igual a la sumatoria de días de los registros A.' Section 16 'Manejo de planilla tipo N' item h, p.284: 'Siempre que se utilice el tipo de planilla “N – Planilla Correcciones” los operadores de información deberán liquidar los intereses de mora a que haya lugar de acuerdo con la normativa vigente, a excepción del pago de retroactivos salariales; o del reporte de la novedad de retiro cuando se realice en los plazos establecidos en las disposiciones aplicables [...]'.
